Construct a CKKS-backed master

Source: R/sites.R
make_ckks_master.Rd

Construct a CKKS-backed master

Usage

make_ckks_master(name, crypto_context, keypair)

Arguments

name

short identifier shown in printed output.

crypto_context

an openfhe.R CryptoContext configured for CKKS.

keypair

an openfhe.R KeyPair.

Value

a CKKSMaster.
